title: feat(objectql)!: two namespaces may each ship a flow of one name; addresses, actions and endpoints run their own package's (ADR-0150 child B)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg7hU4nqZzq4X97nuFabGxKv)_
epic:#31527#1 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CYAGCZcafN5hk3uj4u

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：flow 名字从「整个部署只能一个包持有」改成「每个命名空间一个包」。两个不同命名空间的包可以各自发同名 flow，各跑各的；同命名空间的共有者、没有命名空间的包、内置名仍然拒绝。
- 为什么改：ADR-0150 D9，史诗 #31527 子卡 B 的 flow 部分，这是第三个也是收尾的 PR。之前第二个包装同名 flow 直接 422，只能改名。
- 谁按包作答：`/automation/:ns/:name` 的读、运行、开关、运行记录都按该命名空间那个包的槽来服务；包自己的 flow action 和 flow endpoint 跑自己包的 flow（D3）。裸名、没有包的 action 和 endpoint 仍然 409，并列出两个持有者。
- 风险与回滚：收窄两处（裸 `/meta/flow` 读两持有者的名字答 409；包调用方按名读只有环境持有、或只有闭包外的包持有的 flow 被拒），第一方调用方 0，dogfood 全量见下方。Studio 的 flow 面板还按裸名调用，共享名会看到 409，另开 follow-up。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`packages/runtime/src/flow-slot-view.ts`，再看 `packages/runtime/src/domains/automation-address.ts`，最后看下方 FROM → TO 表。
- 需要你做的：无。等 #32214 合入后再合一次 main、重跑重叠套件，然后由专题席位安排落地。

Fixes #31696

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — two refusals where a flow was served: the bare `GET /meta/flow/NAME` and `MetadataManager.get('flow', NAME)` with no package answer `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming both holders of a name two packages hold, where they served the first registered; and a package's by-name read of a flow through the registry's package-scoped read refuses a name only the environment holds (D3 (a)) or one package outside its closure holds (D3 step 3), where it served it. Beside them, two widenings: the install door, the item seam and the cold boot's seal admit a second holder of another namespace (was `422`), and `/automation/:ns/:name` serves that namespace's holder of a shared name (was `409`). Every moved answer is in the table below and in the changeset.
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none in this PR — `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md`'s `subflow` row reads two holders of a flow name as "an older clash, never armed"; once two namespaces' flows are armed, that parenthetical is out of date. `skills/**` is outside this card's surface, so it is a follow-up for the skills lane. No doc in `content/docs/` teaches a flow name as one per deployment.

**Narrowing: yes** — first-party callers: **0** (the dogfood battery, below, boots every example app with the change).

## Moved answers (FROM → TO)

| # | Surface | FROM | TO | Clause-② arm | Pinned in |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | A second package of ANOTHER namespace shipping a held flow name: install door (`SchemaRegistry.installPackage`), item seam (`registerItem`), cold-boot seal | `422 PLUGIN_REGISTER_FAILED` (cold boot: one `Bare-name conflict at boot` warning) | admitted, each flow armed in its own slot; no warning | widening | objectql `registry-bare-name-one-holder-flow-family.test.ts` (the narrowing describe); dogfood `flow-name-per-namespace` (gamma), `bare-name-one-holder-flow-family` (gamma) |
| 2 | A co-owner of the holder's namespace, a package with no namespace, a built-in name | `422` (`install-local` co-owner: `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE`) | unchanged | — | objectql flow-family; dogfood co-owner |
| 3 | Bare `GET /meta/flow/NAME`, `MetadataManager.get('flow', NAME)` with no package, a name two packages hold | first registered (reachable only after a sealed cold-boot clash) | `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming both | narrowing | metadata `metadata-manager-match-endpoint.test.ts`; dogfood |
| 4 | A package caller's by-name read of a flow only the environment holds (registry package-scoped read) | served | refused (D3 (a)) | narrowing | objectql `package-scoped-e8-readers.test.ts` "flow joins the readers" |
| 5 | A package caller's by-name read of a flow one package outside its closure holds | served | refused (D3 step 3) | narrowing | same |
| 6 | `/automation/:ns/:name` read, run (`…/trigger`, legacy `/automation/trigger/:ns/:name`), toggle, runs, run read, on a name two packages hold | `409` naming both | served from that namespace's package's slot; the other package's run is `404 RUN_NOT_FOUND` there | widening | runtime `automation-addressed-route.test.ts`; dogfood |
| 7 | `/automation/:ns/:name` `PUT`, `DELETE`, `…/clone`, on a shared name | `409` | unchanged | — | runtime addressed-route |
| 8 | Bare `/automation/:name`; a namespace holding neither; an engine with no slot entries | `409` | unchanged (fail closed) | — | runtime addressed-route; dogfood |
| 9 | Package P's flow action and flow endpoint, `target` a name two packages hold | `409` (the engine's bare refusal) | P's own flow, else the one holder in P's closure, from its slot | widening | runtime `flow-caller-package.test.ts`; dogfood |
| 10 | An action or endpoint with no package (or whose registry cannot be read), shared `target` | `409` | unchanged | — | runtime flow-caller-package (CONTROL) |
| 11 | A package's action whose closure reaches neither holder | `409` from the engine | `409` naming both, from the resolver, before anything is read or run | — | runtime flow-caller-package |
| 12 | Package-less `PUT /meta/flow/NAME` of a shared name | `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE` (the managed seal) | unchanged, nothing stored, never a `500` | — | dogfood |
| 13 | Epic Q4: a flow the deployment switched off while P1 held its name, then P2 (another namespace) installs one | P2 could not install | P1's flow stays off (`409 FLOW_DISABLED` at its address), P2's arms and runs; the ledger row stays P1's | — | service-automation `flow-slots-per-package.test.ts` (#31696 ledger describe); dogfood Q4 |

## What changes

- **The switch.** `flow` joins `NAMESPACE_SCOPED_BARE_NAME_TYPES` (`@objectstack/core`), `PACKAGE_SLOTTED_STORE_TYPES` (`@objectstack/metadata`) and `PACKAGE_SCOPED_READ_TYPES` (`@objectstack/objectql`) in one stroke. The bare-name rule (`bare-name-one-holder.ts`) is set-driven, so only its docs move.
- **`/automation` addresses** (`packages/runtime/src/domains/automation-address.ts`, `automation.ts`). When an address's namespace names the one holder of a shared name, `admitAutomationAddress` answers `slot` instead of `409`, and the door reads through `flowSlotView` (new, `packages/runtime/src/flow-slot-view.ts`): the same service with `execute`, `getFlow`, `toggleFlow`, the run lists and the run reads bound to that package's slot (`executeSlot`, `getFlowSlot`, `toggleFlowSlot`, `flowSlotKey`). Every step of the door reads the one flow; none falls back to the bare name. The writes keep their `409`.
- **Flow actions and flow endpoints** (`action-execution.ts`, `action-dispatch.ts`, `endpoint-executor.ts`, `dispatcher-plugin.ts`). `flowServiceForCaller` resolves the `target` from the caller's package with `resolvePackageScopedName` (own item, else the one holder in the closure, else refused naming every candidate) only when the bare name is refused; a name one package holds keeps the bare read, exactly as before. The action's package is its own stamp, else its object's; the endpoint's is the holder of its `api` item. No package, no registry, or no slot entries: the service itself, whose bare entries refuse (fail closed).
- **Tests and doubles.** The objectql family pins, the e8 readers, the metadata slot pins and the protocol testkit (`no-package-scoped-reads.testkit.ts`: a double now reads `flow` by package) follow the switch; three runtime doubles declare `readsByPackage` for `flow`.

## Why

ADR-0150 D2/D9 narrow the one-holder rule to the namespace; D3 resolves a bare name from the caller's package; D4 slots the engine by `(package, name)`; D5 addresses a holder by namespace. PR-1 and PR-2 (#32374) landed the engine's slots, arming, triggers, hooks and the per-slot activation ledger. This PR turns the rule on for `flow` and makes every door that knows which package it means read that package's flow (seat ruling 6810580480: the action and endpoint doors in this PR, red line 3).

## Verification

- **Red first, on `main` f0f729e7**: with the six runtime wiring files reverted to `main` (the new `flow-slot-view.ts` kept), exactly the four "served" pins fail (P's action, P's endpoint, the address read/run/toggle/runs, the address run read); the other 49, every CONTROL included, pass.
- **Ablation** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, mutation landed and restored to HEAD): `flowServiceForCaller` returning the bare service instead of the slot view turns exactly the four served pins red (own flow, closure holder, P's action, P's endpoint); the 49 others stay green.
- **Suites**: on the merged tree (`main` 1af82539 merged, `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm build`): core 145 files / 3327 tests (the one narrowed-set pin moved with the switch, re-run green), objectql 586 / 12300, metadata 73 / 1318, metadata-protocol 334 (+5 skipped) / 22686, runtime 582 / 9880 (`--project local`). The full multi-project runtime run before the merge read 579 of 586 files green; the 7 others failed on doubles with no `getObjectQL`, which the wiring now reads only for a packaged caller and fails closed without (those 7 re-run green). service-automation is not touched (277 files / 3756 tests green with the switch at step 0).
- **Typecheck**: `tsc --noEmit` clean in core, objectql, metadata, metadata-protocol, runtime; `check:test-typecheck` OK in runtime, objectql and core (no ledger growth).
- **`pnpm lint`**: exit 0.
- **Gates** (`dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` on the final tree, each exit code recorded before any pipe, reconciled with `--ran`): 78 derived; 77 run, every one exit 0 (`check:test-source-alias` first answered 1 for `flow-caller-package.test.ts`, fixed with the module-top `import '@objectstack/metadata'` and re-run 0); 1 NOT MEASURED: `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` exits 3 (the checker's own self-test does not reach its verdict in this container: a prerequisite, not this diff). `--ran`: 78 derived, 77 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. Dogfood `tsc --noEmit` exit 0 (with an 8 GB heap; the default heap runs out in this container).
- **Dogfood**: the full battery on 290d918a (the merged tree, full build): 452 files passed, 3 skipped (455); 3784 tests passed, 42 skipped. It includes the new `flow-name-per-namespace.dogfood.test.ts` (9) and the edited `bare-name-one-holder-flow-family.dogfood.test.ts` (4).
- **Size**: 1331 (+1223 / −108, 26 files) changed lines.

## Acceptance notes and declared residuals

- **Not narrowed here, deliberately**: a packaged action whose `target` ONE package holds, outside the action's closure, keeps today's bare run. Narrowing it would refuse a one-holder name that runs today (red line 3: bare names keep resolving to the unique holder).
- **The environment overlay** of P's action or endpoint uses P's stamp, as the action E2 precedent does.
- **The sealed-save sentence** (row 12) names one holder's customization pair as the place to declare an override (the protocol's `packagedArtifactOwner` reads the artifact by bare name). The refusal and its code are right and nothing is stored; the sentence would read better naming every holder. Follow-up, outside this card's surface.
- **Studio** (objectui) addresses flows by bare name (`FlowRunsPanel`, `FlowRunner` resume, `flowLaunch`, `packagedFlowLedger`, `FlowItemMoreMenu` clone, `FlowRunsPage`): on a shared name it reads the `409` naming both until it addresses by namespace. Follow-up on the epic ledger.
- **B-shape item 5** (the served holder set) rides #32183, not here.
- **Landing order**: #32214 lands first; this branch merges `main` after it (no rebase) and re-runs the overlapping suites (the three type sets, the objectql family pins, the e8 readers, the metadata slot pins, the flow-family dogfood).
